settings.title: Electronic invoicing (SDI)
settings.description: FatturaPA files for business invoices, sent to the Sistema di Interscambio.

scope.title: Only invoices to businesses go through the SDI
scope.text: Healthcare invoices to private persons may not be electronic (art. 10-bis DL 119/2018): they stay as PDF and are reported to the Sistema Tessera Sanitaria. An invoice becomes an SDI file only when its recipient has a partita IVA.

sdi_it.riferimentoHelp: Printed in the exempt summary (Natura N4), e.g. Esente IVA art. 10 n. 18 DPR 633/72.
sdi_it.bolloHelp: Declares DatiBollo on exempt invoices over the threshold; the amount is not added to the invoice total.

transportOpt.manual: Manual — download the file, upload it yourself, import the receipt
transportOpt.manualHelp: You download each XML from the records page, upload it in Fatture e Corrispettivi or send it from your PEC client, and import the receipt the SDI returns.
transportOpt.pec: PEC — the practice's certified mailbox sends and receives
transportOpt.pecHelp: Every two minutes the system sends pending files from your PEC mailbox to the SDI and reads the receipts it sends back. No accreditation needed.

pec.sdiAddressHelp: sdi01{'@'}pec.fatturapa.it for the first file; the SDI answers from a dedicated address, which is stored here automatically.

records.title: SDI files
records.description: Every business invoice becomes an FPR12 file; follow it from generation to the SDI receipt.

panel.title: Sistema di Interscambio
panel.notApplicable: Invoice to a private person: not sent to the SDI (art. 10-bis DL 119/2018). Issued as PDF; the expense is reported to the Sistema Tessera Sanitaria.
panel.buildError: The SDI file could not be built
panel.noRecord: No SDI file for this invoice yet.
panel.receiptHelp: Pick the XML the SDI returned (…_RC_…, …_NS_…, …_MC_…) or paste its contents.
panel.requeued: New file generated with the same number
panel.markedExported: Marked as uploaded — waiting for the receipt
panel.undeliverableHint: The SDI could not deliver the file: it is in the recipient's reserved area. Tell the recipient by other means.
panel.rejectedHint: Rejected by the SDI. Correct the invoice data, then regenerate: the new file keeps the same number and date.

badge.error: SDI file could not be built
